title: Patent FTO search round 3 (CN/JP/KR and applicant-name queries)
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The project is open and files no patents, but builders must respect active third-party patents. Rounds 1–2 did not query CN/JP/KR databases directly or search by applicant (Gerstlauer, Intamin, Maurer, Zierer, Vekoma, Mack, Universal family members).
objective: Extend docs/research/patentability-fto.md with an FTO-only round 3 and track the pending CN/JP/KR/CA counterparts of US 11,975,679.
acceptanceCriteria: Only real, verifiable patent numbers with links
Each finding states which RideBelt feature it touches and any design-around
States clearly that it is not a legal opinion
